Name: Mint's Elephant Bird
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]Adds a new Large Bird that can be hatched in a Barn with an ostrich incubator, takes 5 days to hatch and 9 days to mature.

The Elephant Bird will produce 1 egg every 8 days that can be turned into 3 mayo in a mayonnaise machine.

You can get the Elephant Bird egg at the Island Trader for 2 Ostrich eggs[/size]
[size=3]
Installation:
﻿[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install Mint's Elephant Bird[/size][/*]
[/list]
